'''Chandrilan grappaberries''' were a type of [[Berry/Legends|berry]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. Grappaberries grown in [[Plant/Legends|vineyards]] around the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nayli]] were fermented and used to make [[Chandrilan Blue '439]], a vintage of fine [[Wine/Legends|wine]].<ref name="SoR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chandrilan grappaberries were mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' expansion ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="SoR" />
